title: Neon Project
description: A Neon project is the top-level object in the Neon hierarchy containing branches, databases, roles, and compute endpoints for a serverless Postgres deployment.

id.description: The unique project identifier assigned by Neon

region_id.description: The cloud region where the project is deployed (e.g., aws-us-east-1, aws-eu-central-1)

provisioner.description: The provisioner type used for compute resources

store_passwords.description: Whether connection passwords are stored and retrievable

active_time.description: Total active time of compute endpoints in seconds

cpu_used_sec.description: Total CPU seconds consumed by compute endpoints

creation_source.description: The source that created this project (e.g., console, api)

org_id.description: The organization ID this project belongs to

created_at.description: Timestamp when the project was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated

EndpointSettings.description: Default settings applied to new compute endpoints in this project

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds of inactivity before the endpoint is automatically suspended
